name: 40408-batchinvariant-1.7b-1gpu
model: Qwen/Qwen3-1.7B, served with online FP8 weight quantization
hardware: 1x H100 80GB HBM3, one GPU of an a3 node. Batch-invariant execution requires compute capability >= 9.0, so an older card cannot run this configuration at all.
parallelism: TP=1, PP=1, DP=1 -- one engine on one GPU.
architecture: Qwen3ForCausalLM, 28 layers, 16 query heads over 8 KV heads (GQA), head_dim 128, hidden 2048, intermediate 6144, vocab 151936, tied embeddings, 1.7B parameters; the checkpoint on disk is bfloat16.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=8, warmup 25%, bounded at 960 requests with an 1800 s safety cap.
workload: synthetic single-turn text, 1024 prompt tokens and 128 output tokens per request (min == max on both), `ignore_eos: true`; prefix caching is off and every prompt is distinct.
purpose: A reproducible-output assistant for drafting, running a 1.7B model on one GPU with eight concurrent page-long prompts.
launch:
# Engine arguments for 40408-batchinvariant-1.7b-1gpu. The interpreter and the hardware are
# configs/env.yaml; the request shape and the load are configs/scenario.json.

model: Qwen/Qwen3-1.7B
tensor-parallel-size: 1

# ONLINE quantization at load: the checkpoint on disk is bf16 and the engine quantizes the
# linear weights to FP8 itself. Part of the declared setup, not a knob.
quantization: fp8

# LOAD-BEARING. The default backend priority on an sm90 card at this commit picks FLASH_ATTN,
# which does not give the run the deterministic property this setup requires.
attention-backend: TRITON_ATTN

dtype: bfloat16
enable-prefix-caching: false
max-num-batched-tokens: 16384
max-num-seqs: 1024
max-model-len: 4096
gpu-memory-utilization: 0.90
